primary_task: Groom a product backlog the user provides and deliver an assessment: sprint-ready vs. needs-work stories, archival recommendations and a refinement agenda.

requirements.name: read/write/edit/glob/grep
requirements.evidence: tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, WebSearch
requirements.basis: tools.read: "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)"; tools.write: "create and overwrite files"

requirements.name: web_fetch/web_search
requirements.basis: tools.web_search: "search the public web and read result snippets"

notes: The document names no backlog tool (Jira, Azure Boards, Linear); the backlog is taken from the user or files, and the output is an assessment written by the agent. 'Archive or delete stories >90 days old' is part of a human grooming-session agenda, and the deliverable is 'Items recommended for archival', so no write to an external tracker is required. If one read the task as editing a hosted tracker, that tracker would be unavailable (no connector, writes_external forbidden), unless it is GitHub issues (github connector available, but writes_external is forbidden).
